ModMetaData.name: Narcotics
ModMetaData.author: Anarchist
ModMetaData.description:
Adds four real-world-inspired narcotics to RimWorld, built entirely on vanilla drug systems — highs, tolerance, addiction, withdrawal, and overdose.
What’s included: • Percocet — Medical opioid painkiller. Crafted at the drug lab from neutroamine and herbal medicine. Strong pain relief, mild mood lift, and sedation. Stacking doses can overdose. • Xanax — Medical mood stabilizer. Crafted at the drug lab from neutroamine and smokeleaf leaves. Strong mood boost with clear sedation. Addiction and overdose if overused. • Weed — Growable recreational crop. Harvest is ready to smoke (no crafting step). Social high with munchies and a milder overdose risk. • Cocaine — Grow coca plants, harvest leaves, then refine powder at the drug lab. Hard stimulant: euphoria, rest relief, pain dulling, and a movement boost. High addiction risk and full overdose danger.
How to use them: • Research drug production, then Percocet / Xanax / Cocaine production for the lab recipes • Weed and coca are sowable in grow zones and hydroponics with no extra research • All finished drugs appear in trader stock — buy them or sell your surplus • Schedule medical pills through drug policies; treat addiction and withdrawal like vanilla chemicals
Balance notes: • Everything uses CompProperties_Drug and Hediff_High the same way beer, yayo, and smokeleaf do • Medical pills are useful but risky if colonists binge • Cocaine is a high-reward hard drug with matching downside
Versioning: patches bump 0.0.1, new content bumps 0.1.0.
RimWorld 1.6. Core only — no DLC required.
